methodology.snapshot_frequency: One end-of-day Git snapshot per calendar date.
methodology.modern_signal_sampling: Only action changes are retained to avoid repeated daily recommendations overweighting the sample.
methodology.legacy_opportunity_definition: Entry into daily top 10 with score >= 75. This is a research cohort and is NOT relabeled as BUY.
methodology.legacy_defensive_definition: Explicit dashboard RİSK / ALARM or DİKKAT transition. This is NOT relabeled as REDUCE or EXIT.
methodology.foundation_filter: Modern snapshots requiring LIVE market data; FOUNDATION snapshots are excluded.
methodology.entry_price_basis: Adjusted Yahoo Finance daily close on or before signal date.

claim_guardrails: The V8.0 49.6% hit rate is not a sell-only hit rate; it mixes strategic action changes. Use modern_by_action or modern_defensive_reduce_exit for sell-specific evidence.
Legacy opportunity and portfolio-alert cohorts use older signal semantics and must not be pooled blindly with V7/V8 BUY/REDUCE/EXIT recommendations.
This evidence recovery does not remove survivorship bias from the V8.0 current-portfolio backtest.
